title: RoboWorld 2026 — Track 1: WorldNav
description: Language-conditioned open-loop visual navigation and trajectory prediction in continuous 3D environments. The WorldNav track of the RoboWorld Challenge 2026, affiliated with the RoboPAD Workshop at NeurIPS 2026.
description_zh: 连续三维环境中的语言条件化开环视觉导航与轨迹预测。RoboWorld Challenge 2026的WorldNav赛道，隶属于NeurIPS 2026的RoboPAD研讨会。

pages.title: Overview
pages.content: # RoboWorld 2026 Track 1: WorldNav Welcome to WorldNav, the language-conditioned visual navigation track of the RoboWorld 2026, affiliated with the RoboPAD Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. An agent receives one initial egocentric RGB image and a natural-language instruction. It must predict a complete navigation action sequence without a goal image, an initial numeric pose, or further observations from the environment. World models, vision-language-action models, and policy-only methods are welcome. ## Task Definition Submit variable-length sequences of `[dx, dy, dyaw]` actions. `dx` means forward motion and `dy` means leftward motion in the agent's current local frame; `dyaw` changes heading in radians. The private evaluator uses the recorded initial pose to reconstruct the predicted route. Test participants receive only the initial image and instruction, not the pose, goal, reference trajectory, or reference action sequence. ## Phases Phase 1 is for development and validation. Final rankings and awards are based entirely on Phase 2; phase scores are not combined. Check the active phase dates on CodaBench before submitting. | Phase |   | Evaluation data |   | Ranking | |:--|:--:|:--|:--:|:--| | Phase 1: Validation |   | Released `val_seen` and `val_unseen` inputs |   | Mean of `val_seen` and `val_unseen` Scores (50% each) | | Phase 2: Final Evaluation |   | Held-out test inputs |   | Test Score | ## Awards & Recognition Official challenge awards follow the [RoboWorld 2026 Awards & Recognition](https://roboworld2026.github.io/#awards) guidelines: - **Certificates of Recognition**: The **Top 5 teams in each track** will receive official certificates recognizing their achievements in the RoboWorld Challenge 2026. A **Best Innovative Solution** award will also recognize outstanding creativity and technical innovation. - **Oral Presentations**: Selected top-performing teams will be invited to give **oral presentations** at the **RoboPAD Workshop** at **NeurIPS 2026**, sharing their methods, results, and insights with the research community. ## Resources and Contact | Resource |   | Link | |:--|:--:|:--| | Challenge Website |   | [RoboWorld 2026](https://roboworld2026.github.io) | | Official Track 1 Website |   | [RoboWorld 2026 — Track 1: WorldNav](https://roboworld2026.github.io/track1) | | Track 1 Repository |   | [worldnav-challenge](https://github.com/F1y1113/worldnav-challenge) | | Evaluation & Leaderboard |   | [CodaBench Competition #18185](https://www.codabench.org/competitions/18185/) | | Dataset |   | [LCVN on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/fly1113/LCVN) | | Baseline Implementation |   | [LCVN Repository](https://github.com/UWMILab/LCVN) | For technical support, use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/F1y1113/worldnav-challenge/issues). For event and registration questions, email [roboworld2026@gmail.com](mailto:roboworld2026@gmail.com). ### 💬 Community & Discussion - **Discord:** [Join the RoboWorld Track 1 Discord](https://discord.gg/gv2yW3TaA) - **WeChat Group:** [Join the RoboWorld Track 1 WeChat Group](https://github.com/roboworld2026/roboworld2026.github.io/blob/main/wechat_track1.JPG)
pages.content_zh: # RoboWorld 2026 赛道1：WorldNav 欢迎来到WorldNav，这是RoboWorld 2026的语言条件视觉导航赛道，隶属于NeurIPS 2026的RoboPAD研讨会。 智能体接收一张初始的自我中心RGB图像和一条自然语言指令。它必须在没有目标图像、初始数值姿态或来自环境的进一步观测的情况下，预测完整的导航动作序列。欢迎使用世界模型、视觉-语言-动作模型以及纯策略方法。 ## 任务定义 提交可变长度的`[dx, dy, dyaw]`动作序列。`dx`表示前向运动，`dy`表示智能体当前局部坐标系中的左向运动；`dyaw`以弧度改变朝向。 私有评估器使用记录的初始姿态来重建预测路径。测试参与者仅接收初始图像和指令，而不接收姿态、目标、参考轨迹或参考动作序列。 ## 阶段 第1阶段用于开发和验证。最终排名和奖项完全基于第2阶段；阶段分数不合并。提交前请在CodaBench上查看当前阶段日期。 | 阶段 |   | 评估数据 |   | 排名 | |:--|:--:|:--|:--:|:--| | 第1阶段：验证 |   | 发布的`val_seen`和`val_unseen`输入 |   | `val_seen`和`val_unseen`分数的平均值（各占50%）| | 第2阶段：最终评估 |   | 保留的测试输入 |   | 测试分数 | ## 奖项与认可 官方竞赛奖项遵循[RoboWorld 2026奖项与认可](https://roboworld2026.github.io/#awards)指南： - **认可证书**：**每个赛道的前5名团队**将获得官方证书，以表彰他们在RoboWorld Challenge 2026中的成就。还将颁发**最佳创新解决方案**奖，以表彰杰出的创造力和技术创新。 - **口头报告**：选出的顶尖团队将被邀请在**NeurIPS 2026**的**RoboPAD研讨会**上进行**口头报告**，与研究界分享他们的方法、结果和见解。 ## 资源与联系方式 | 资源 |   | 链接 | |:--|:--:|:--| | 竞赛网站 |   | [RoboWorld 2026](https://roboworld2026.github.io) | | 赛道1官方网站 |   | [RoboWorld 2026 — 赛道1：WorldNav](https://roboworld2026.github.io/track1) | | 赛道1代码库 |   | [worldnav-challenge](https://github.com/F1y1113/worldnav-challenge) | | 评估与排行榜 |   | [CodaBench竞赛 #18185](https://www.codabench.org/competitions/18185/) | | 数据集 |   | [Hugging Face上的LCVN](https://huggingface.co/datasets/fly1113/LCVN) | | 基线实现 |   | [LCVN代码库](https://github.com/UWMILab/LCVN) | 如需技术支持，请使用[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/F1y1113/worldnav-challenge/issues)。 如有关于活动和注册的问题，请发送邮件至[roboworld2026@gmail.com](mailto:roboworld2026@gmail.com)。 ### 💬 社区与讨论 - **Discord：**[加入RoboWorld赛道1 Discord](https://discord.gg/gv2yW3TaA) - **微信群：**[加入RoboWorld赛道1微信群](https://github.com/roboworld2026/roboworld2026.github.io/blob/main/wechat_track1.JPG)

pages.title: Submission & Evaluation
pages.content:
# Submission & Evaluation

Submit predicted action sequences in a ZIP archive, using only each episode's initial RGB image and instruction.

## Action format

Each action is [dx, dy, dyaw]: forward displacement, leftward displacement in the agent's **current local frame**, and yaw update in radians. Sequences may have different lengths; the JSON list ends the trajectory.


Limits: at most 64 actions per episode; hypot(dx,dy) ≤ 2.46 dataset coordinate units and |dyaw| ≤ 6.29 rad per action (evaluated modulo 2π in [−π, π)).

## ZIP layout

Put the required JSON files at the archive root. The downloadable example ZIP shows the layout and Phase 1 episode IDs; replace its illustrative actions.

| Phase |   | Required files |
| :-- | :--: | :-- |
| Phase 1 |   | val_seen.json, val_unseen.json |
| Phase 2 |   | test.json |

### JSON schema

Each file contains split and episodes. Include every phase episode_id exactly once, with an actions list:

    {
      "split": "val_unseen",
      "episodes": [
        {
          "episode_id": "20210826_40_0001_02_0",
          "actions": [[0.25, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, 0.15], [0.12, -0.05, 0.0]]
        }
      ]
    }

This abbreviated example is not a complete submission.

## Evaluation metrics

The two fidelity metrics range from 0 to 1. See [demonstration.py](https://github.com/F1y1113/worldnav-challenge/blob/main/demonstration.py) for the five calculations.

| Metric |   | Direction |   | Meaning |
| :-- | :--: | :-- | :--: | :-- |
| **Success Rate (SR)** |   | Higher |   | Fraction meeting the final-position success criterion. |
| **Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE)** |   | Lower |   | Position error over the reference trajectory. |
| **Relative Pose Error (RPE)** |   | Lower |   | Relative translation error between consecutive poses. |
| **Full-route fidelity** |   | Higher |   | Agreement with the complete ordered recorded route, including a penalty for unnecessary travel. |
| **Heading and turn fidelity** |   | Higher |   | Agreement of facing direction while moving and of the direction, position, and amount of turns. |

## Composite Score

Each episode is scored first, then the contributions are averaged:

    Score = (100/N) × Σ_i { FullRouteFidelity_i × (1 + HeadingTurnFidelity_i)/2
                          × [0.70 + 0.10 SR_i + 0.10/(1+ATE_i) + 0.10/(1+RPE_i)] }

SR_i is binary success; ATE_i and RPE_i are per-episode errors in dataset coordinate units. Score averages episode contributions.

Phase 1 ranks by `(Score_val_seen + Score_val_unseen) / 2`, with equal weight for each split. Both split files are required; a submission missing either file is rejected. Both split Scores are displayed. Phase 2 ranks by test Score.
pages.content_zh:
# 提交与评估

将预测的动作序列提交至ZIP压缩包，仅使用每个片段的初始RGB图像和指令。

## 动作格式

每个动作为[dx, dy, dyaw]：前向位移、智能体**当前局部坐标系**中的左向位移，以及偏航角更新（弧度制）。序列长度可不同；JSON列表标记轨迹结束。

限制：每个片段最多64个动作；单次动作的hypot(dx,dy) ≤ 2.46数据集坐标单位且|dyaw| ≤ 6.29弧度（在[−π, π)范围内对2π取模计算）。

## ZIP文件结构

将所需的JSON文件置于压缩包根目录。可下载的示例ZIP展示了文件结构和第一阶段片段ID；替换其中的示例动作。

| 阶段 |   | 所需文件 |
| :-- | :--: | :-- |
| 第一阶段 |   | val_seen.json, val_unseen.json |
| 第二阶段 |   | test.json |

### JSON模式

每个文件包含数据集划分和片段。每个阶段的episode_id必须且只能出现一次，附带动作列表：

    {
      "split": "val_unseen",
      "episodes": [
        {
          "episode_id": "20210826_40_0001_02_0",
          "actions": [[0.25, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, 0.15], [0.12, -0.05, 0.0]]
        }
      ]
    }

此简化示例并非完整提交。

## 评估指标

两个保真度指标范围为0到1。五种计算方法参见[demonstration.py](https://github.com/F1y1113/worldnav-challenge/blob/main/demonstration.py)。

| 指标 |   | 方向 |   | 含义 |
| :-- | :--: | :-- | :--: | :-- |
| **成功率 (SR)** |   | 越高越好 |   | 满足最终位置成功标准的比例。 |
| **绝对轨迹误差 (ATE)** |   | 越低越好 |   | 相对于参考轨迹的位置误差。 |
| **相对位姿误差 (RPE)** |   | 越低越好 |   | 连续位姿之间的相对平移误差。 |
| **全路径保真度** |   | 越高越好 |   | 与完整有序记录路径的一致性，包括对不必要移动的惩罚。 |
| **航向与转向保真度** |   | 越高越好 |   | 移动时朝向以及转向方向、位置和幅度的一致性。 |

## 综合得分

首先对每个片段进行评分，然后取平均值：

    Score = (100/N) × Σ_i { FullRouteFidelity_i × (1 + HeadingTurnFidelity_i)/2
                          × [0.70 + 0.10 SR_i + 0.10/(1+ATE_i) + 0.10/(1+RPE_i)] }

SR_i为二元成功标志；ATE_i和RPE_i为每个片段在数据集坐标单位下的误差。得分取各片段贡献的平均值。

第一阶段按`(Score_val_seen + Score_val_unseen) / 2`排名，两个划分权重相等。两个划分的文件都必须提交；缺少任一文件的提交将被拒绝。两个划分的得分均会显示。第二阶段按测试集得分排名。
